Name: Daily Orders
Author: wlyra
Description:
[b]Welcome to Daily Orders! [/b]Are you tired of the same repetitive requests on the Pelican Town order board? Do you want a truly dynamic economy, unique seasonal events, and a system that actually gets harder as you progress? [b]Daily Orders[/b] completely overhauls the daily quest system to bring life, challenge, and massive rewards to your Stardew Valley experience.[b]If you're ready, you can start by pressing the (Y) key.[/b]

[b]🌟 Main Features:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Massive Dynamic Quest Pool:[/b] A completely rebuilt request system. NPCs will ask for a huge variety of seasonal crops, forageables, artisan goods, and mining resources.
[/list][list]
[*][b]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM) Support:[/b] Fully customizable! Adjust profit multipliers, VIP order chances, and the number of daily quests directly from the game menu.
[/list][b]📅 Unique Seasonal Events:[/b]On specific days, the standard order board transforms into special, high-reward, lore-friendly community events!
[list]
[*][b]Spring 16 (Market War):[/b] Pierre and Morris compete for local supplies. Choose a side!
[*][b]Summer 21 (Drink Break):[/b] The town needs to cool off. Supply Shane, Pam, and Wlyra ( :D ) with their favorite drinks for massive payouts.
[*][b]Fall 8 (Art Project):[/b] Help Leah and Robin gather wood and hardwood for their grand masterpieces.
[*][b]Winter 19 (Winter Concert):[/b] Supply Sam, Sebastian, and Abigail with batteries, refined quartz, and stage materials for an underground winter concert.
[/list][b]🌑 The Mysterious Market (Black Market):[/b]Every [b]13th of the month at 8:00 PM[/b], the order board icon turns purple. The Wizard, Dwarf, Mister Qi, and Sandy will request exotic and highly dangerous items for astronomical prices.


[b]🔥 Year 2+ Hardcore Scaling Economy:[/b]The game shouldn't be easy forever! Once you reach [b]Year 2[/b], the mod automatically shifts into Hardcore Mode:
[list]
[*][b]More Complex Orders:[/b] NPCs will now ask for up to 3 different types of items at once instead of just 1 or 2.
[*][b]Higher Quantities:[/b] Requested item amounts increase by 50%.
[*][b]Sweeter Rewards:[/b] Gold payouts get a 60% boost to match your late-game economy.
[*][b]Luxury Items Unlocked:[/b] In Year 2+, NPCs will start demanding premium items like Diamonds, Gold Bars, Truffle Oil, Starfruit, and Purple Mushrooms.
[/list]

[list]
[/list][b]Installation:[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [b]SMAPI[/b].

[*](Optional but recommended) Install [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b].

[*]Download this mod and extract the [code]DailyOrders[/code] folder into your [code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code] folder.

[*]Run the game!
[/list]

[b]Please feel free to report any problems or bugs you find. This is my first mod attempt, and I'm trying to improve. I would be very grateful if you could share any ideas you have to help improve my mod. 😍​😍​
[/b][list=1]

[/list]
